reason: Pinned Ribasim applies a storage-dependent low-storage factor to infiltration. Therefore one assignment request:=realized does not in general produce a fixed point on the next same-origin physical replay.

corrected_E3_contract.origin: Every iteration restarts from the same accepted Ribasim initial state and same accepted SWAP origin.
iteration: SWAP candidate request q_n is represented by the source-derived external head that yields q_n under the frozen single-level extended-exchange law.
Ribasim is rerun from its same accepted initial state with |q_n| as infiltration request.
Measured physical realization r_n is returned as receipt.
If |r_n-q_n| exceeds tolerance, SWAP commit must fail closed and the candidate is discarded.
Set q_(n+1)=r_n and repeat from the same accepted origins.
Commit is permitted only on an iteration whose measured receipt matches its request within tolerance.
corrected_E3_contract.tolerance_mapping: At represented area 100 m2, 1e-8 m3 corresponds exactly to 1e-8 cm water depth; use the same bound for final F-APP09 publication readiness.

unchanged: Ribasim E3 initial level 0.0775 m and profile bottom 0.0675 m
scientific_effect: Strengthens G7 from a one-replay assumption to an actual same-origin coupled fixed-point/recomposition contract. No observed product endpoint is used to tune a tolerance.
supersedes: Original G7 receipt_match_tolerance_cm=1e-10 for the iterative E3 fixed-point commit only; E1/E2 remain far inside either bound.
anti_tuning: The 1e-8 bound is derived from the preregistered physical fixed-point tolerance and area conversion before the decisive iterative run, not fitted to an observed endpoint.
